tender.title: Regional Patient Record Interoperability Platform
tender.raw_text: Northgate Regional Health Authority runs eleven hospitals on four different electronic patient record systems, and clinicians re-enter allergy and medication data whenever a patient is transferred. We require an interoperability layer that exposes patient summaries through HL7 FHIR APIs, with a master patient index that matches records across the four systems. Access must be role-based, and every read of a patient record must be audit-logged and kept for seven years. Data may not leave the national health cloud region. A clinical dashboard must show transfer delays and duplicate-record rates to hospital managers.
requirements: HL7 FHIR API exposing patient summaries from four record systems
Master patient index matching duplicate records across systems
Role-based access with an audit log of every record read kept seven years
Hosting restricted to the national health cloud region
Dashboard of transfer delays and duplicate-record rates for hospital managers
